mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) relative to its 10-year average compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, increasing present value of future earnings and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods with FEDFUNDS < 3.5% are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending power and corporate earnings growth, which triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods with UNRATE > 4.5% are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1400 and payroll employment (PAYEMS) below 150000 signals contraction in consumer-driven sectors, reducing household income and retail demand, which produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods meeting both HOUST < 1400 and PAYEMS < 150000 are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
